settings.heading: Planters, vases and coasters, printed in Lebanon.
settings.text: Three small pieces for your home, drawn by Ply and printed in small batches. In bone, charcoal or terracotta, from $10.
settings.note: Cash on delivery · Free delivery from $35

settings.title: Cash on delivery
settings.text: Pay the courier when it arrives

settings.heading: Three pieces, three colours.
settings.text: Pick a colour and add it straight to your cart, or take all three as a set.

settings.heading: Planter, vase and coasters in one colour.
settings.text: A small planter, the bud vase and the coaster set, packed together. An easy housewarming gift.

settings.heading: A small 3D-printing studio in Lebanon.
settings.text: We draw every shape ourselves and print it layer by layer, 0.2 mm at a time, then finish and pack each piece by hand. The planter and the vase share one fluted rib. The coasters carry a pattern drawn from the cement tiles of old Lebanese homes.

settings.title: The fluted rib
settings.text: On the planter and the bud vase. It catches the light and hides the print lines.

settings.title: The Beirut tile
settings.text: Raised on each coaster, so you can feel the pattern under your cup.

settings.heading: From our printer to your door.

settings.title: Order here or on WhatsApp
settings.text: No account needed. Just your name, phone and address.

settings.title: We pack it the same day
settings.text: Every piece is checked and wrapped by hand in Lebanon.

settings.title: At your door in 2 to 4 days
settings.text: Pay the courier in cash when it arrives. Delivery is $5, free from $35.

settings.question: Do you deliver everywhere in Lebanon?
settings.answer: Yes. Delivery takes 2 to 4 days and costs $5, free on orders from $35.

settings.question: How do I pay?
settings.answer: In cash when your order arrives. You don't need an account to order.

settings.question: Is the planter good for real plants?
settings.answer: Yes. It has a drainage hole and its own drip tray, so you can water it as usual.

settings.question: Can the bud vase hold water?
settings.answer: It is made for dried or faux stems, because a printed vase isn't reliably watertight.

settings.question: Can I get another colour or my own design?
settings.answer: Not on the site yet. Message us on WhatsApp and we will tell you what we can make.

settings.heading: Rather order by message?
settings.text: Send us the piece and colour on WhatsApp and we take it from there.
